speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The loaf is not done with us. A finger and a half, still. A penny, still.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I set it by the notch. I did not put it on a pan. It is the same short loaf as yesterday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see it. I am not arguing a penny loaf. Threepence for the meal.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence is on the board. I have a hand for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. I am not opening the coffer to find it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The moon was large when I came to the loom. I mention it because it was there. I am not asking you for a meaning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it can be large. I have no meaning for it. I have not begun another play, and I am not sending a letter.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A letter was not on my board. Your threepence is. I am not a woman who repeats a herring.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the chronicle again. I will not shift him for a moon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. The cat has not eaten the book. I am tired, and the wind is still in the street.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The room is still mine. The loaf can be short without a speech.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go up when you have eaten. And do not improve your wife's sentence. It silenced the table once. Once is enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not improving it. I have no better answer than the one I gave, and I am not writing one at this table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the moon in the book upstairs, sir, or only in the street?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will be in the almanac if the almanac has it. I am not making a page of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat the short end and leave the almanac until you are alone. I am not feeding a moon.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have said it was large. That is the whole of my news. The loom does not care what you write under it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. I am eating. Seven days, and this loaf is not one of them.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Seven is a number I can carry. The finger and a half I can see.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See it, and do not put it on a pan to prove it. A penny is the price. The notch is the complaint.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not proving it. I am paying for the meal, and the loaf can be short.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then we are agreed, and I will go back to the silk. The moon will still be large when I look out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have the threepence. I do not need a second speech about a loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Done. Thank you for the board, Mistress.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will leave Gib where he is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave him. A cat on a book is quieter than a man improving a sentence.
